# Collection agency contract notes

The network has used Brightwater Recovery to pursue unpaid balances over 50 dollars since 2017. Under the [[Clearwater Resolution]], late charges no longer go to the agency; only lost item bills do, and those rarely pass the threshold.

The contract renews each July. [[Ines Barrow]] recommends letting it lapse in 2026 and handling the few large lost item bills by letter. The agency's last report listed 38 open accounts, most of them older than three years.
